page.layout: One column of text, full width at top; a woodcut illustration of a globe with a ship and a tower in the middle; running text continues below the illustration. Digitiser's URL at the foot is excluded. Margin letters a, b, c beside the woodcut are part of the illustration and are described under notes.

main_text.p: In tumorem assurgit, qui ex carina prospicientem impedit, in eminenti loco consistentem non impedit, quod mali summitas aut superat aut æquat aquæ tumorem.

Secundo uidemus aquam natura per decliuia ferri, et ex altioribus ad humiliora loca delabi ac confluere, tantisper, donec expleat et exæquet ea, & aliquo concludatur, & coherceatur obstaculo, ne decidat aut diffluat, nec cauitatem in medio aliquam efficit. Colligitur ergo intra uacuos terræ meatus eó usq;, donec superficiem æquet conuexam, & tota appetit & conseruat globi figuram æquabili conuexitate inclusam.
At terram cum circumfluis sibiq; infusis aquis, unum constituere globum, & unam atq; eandem absoluere conuexam superficiem, terra alibi debi scente,
a, b, c: letters of reference on the woodcut, not printed text.

page.notes: The woodcut shows a globe with land, a ship, a castle and a tower, with reference letters a, b, c. Last line "scente," is set at the right margin. Line "debi scente" appears to be a line-end break of "debiscente" (gaping); kept as printed. Some letters in the text are faint.
